note: tC4 src/data/mapReference.ts mapReference() over the tC4 scheme fixtures, for every book both schemes list. widthN: every span of N verses inside each source chapter (width1 = single verses), keyed by its first verse: 'B c:v=B c:verse' (mapped), 'B c:v=!reason[ candidates]' (refused), or the run form 'B c:v1..v2=B c:w', meaning the span starting at v maps to the span of the same width starting at w + v - v1. chapter (from eng only): the whole-chapter span 1-last for chapters of 4 or more verses. Outcomes that map to the same reference are left out.
